HTML Solutions – Two Tasks

This markdown file contains complete HTML code for two tasks:

  1. A personal information page (with your name, address, phone, email, and a paragraph about your career goal).
  2. A school information page with two linked HTML files (main page and a courses page).

All code is ready to copy, paste, and run.

Task 1: Personal Webpage

This page displays your personal details and a career statement. It includes simple CSS for a clean, card‑style layout.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>My Personal Page</title>
</head>
<body>

    <h1>About Me</h1>

    <p>
        <strong>Name:</strong> John Doe<br>
        <strong>Address:</strong> 123 Main Street, Cityville, 45678<br>
        <strong>Phone:</strong> +1 (555) 987-6543<br>
        <strong>Email:</strong> john.doe@example.com
    </p>

    <hr>

    <p>
        <strong>What I want to be:</strong><br>
        I aspire to become a <strong>Full‑Stack Web Developer</strong> who builds meaningful, user‑friendly applications that solve real‑world problems. I am passionate about creating clean, accessible code and continuously learning new technologies. In the future, I hope to lead development teams and contribute to open‑source projects, while also mentoring others who are starting their journey in tech.
    </p>

</body>
</html>

Task 2: School Webpage with Linked Pages

This task consists of two HTML files:

  • index.html – the main page with the school name and menu.
  • courses.html – the information page that lists the courses.

Both are written in plain, minimal HTML (no CSS) for clarity and ease of modification.

File 1: index.html (Main Page)

<html>
<head>
    <title>ABC School</title>
</head>
<body>

    <h1>Welcome to ABC School</h1>

    <ul>
        <li>Management</li>
        <li>Teachers</li>
        <li>Non-teaching staff</li>
        <li><a href="courses.html">Information</a></li>
    </ul>

</body>
</html>

File 2: courses.html (Information Page)

<html>
<head>
    <title>Courses - ABC School</title>
</head>
<body>

    <h2>Courses offered by ABC School in HS under WBCHE</h2>

    <ul>
        <li>Science</li>
        <li>Arts</li>
        <li>Commerce</li>
    </ul>

    <br>
    <a href="index.html">Go Back</a>

</body>
</html>

How to Use

  1. Personal Page – Save the first code as personal.html and open it in any browser.
  2. School Pages – Save the second and third codes as index.html and courses.html in the same folder. Open index.html in your browser and click the Information link to navigate to the courses page.

All code is ready to run. Feel free to replace the placeholder text (name, address, etc.) with your own details.

HTML Solutions – Tasks 3, 4, and 5

  • Task 3: A webpage for Wonderland Park with a background image.
  • Task 4: A frameset page containing two frames – one about Rabindranath Tagore and one about Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.
  • Task 5: A school timetable with a marquee heading and colored background.

All code is ready to copy and run.
(For Task 4, you will need to create three files and place them in the same folder.)

Task 3 – Wonderland Park

This page has a background image, displays the park name, ticket price, and timing.

Note: Replace "background-image-url.jpg" with the actual URL or file path of your image. The example uses a placeholder from via.placeholder.com.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Wonderland Park</title>
    <style>
        body {
            background-image: url('https://via.placeholder.com/1920x1080/cccccc/000000?text=Wonderland+Park');
            background-size: cover;
            background-attachment: fixed;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            color: white;
            text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px #000000;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 50px;
        }
        h1 {
            font-size: 4em;
            margin-top: 100px;
        }
        ul {
            list-style: none;
            font-size: 2em;
            line-height: 2;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <h1>Welcome to Wonderland Park</h1>
    <ul>
        <li>🎟️ Ticket Price – Rs. 50 per head</li>
        <li>🕒 Park Timing – 10:00 to 19:30</li>
    </ul>
</body>
</html>

Task 4 – Frameset with Two Frames (Tagore & Netaji)

This task requires three files:

  1. frameset.html – the main page that divides the screen into two frames.
  2. tagore.html – content about Rabindranath Tagore.
  3. netaji.html – content about Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.

Place all three files in the same folder and open frameset.html.

File 1: frameset.html

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Famous Personalities</title>
</head>
<frameset cols="50%,50%">
    <frame src="tagore.html" name="left">
    <frame src="netaji.html" name="right">
</frameset>
</html>

File 2: tagore.html (Rabindranath Tagore)

  • Background: Yellow
  • Font colour: Green
  • Title: Kabi Guru
  • Contains: parents' names, three popular books (bulleted list), and an image.
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Kabi Guru</title>
    <style>
        body {
            background-color: yellow;
            color: green;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        h1 {
            text-align: center;
        }
        img {
            display: block;
            margin: 20px auto;
            width: 200px;
            border: 2px solid green;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <p><strong>Parents:</strong> Debendranath Tagore & Sarada Devi</p>
    <p><strong>Three Popular Books:</strong></p>
    <ul>
        <li>Gitanjali</li>
        <li>Gora</li>
        <li>The Home and the World</li>

    <img src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8c/Rabindranath_Tagore_%28cropped%29.jpg/220px-Rabindranath_Tagore_%28cropped%29.jpg" alt="Rabindranath Tagore">
</body>
</html>

Task 5 – School Timetable with Marquee

This page displays a daily class routine in a table.

  • Background: pink
  • Font colour: dark red
  • Heading: "Our Daily Class Routine" with a marquee effect.
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>School Timetable</title>
    <style>
        body {
            background-color: pink;
            color: darkred;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 30px;
        }
        h1 {
            font-size: 3em;
        }
        table {
            margin: 20px auto;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            width: 80%;
            background-color: #ffe0e0;
            color: darkred;
        }
        th, td {
            border: 2px solid darkred;
            padding: 12px;
            font-size: 1.2em;
        }
        th {
            background-color: #ffb3b3;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <marquee behavior="scroll" direction="left" scrollamount="6">
        <h1>Our Daily Class Routine</h1>
    </marquee>

    <table>
        <tr>
            <th>Time</th>
            <th>Monday</th>
            <th>Tuesday</th>
            <th>Wednesday</th>
            <th>Thursday</th>
            <th>Friday</th>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td>8:00 – 8:45</td>
            <td>Math</td>
            <td>English</td>
            <td>Science</td>
            <td>Math</td>
            <td>English</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td>8:45 – 9:30</td>
            <td>English</td>
            <td>Math</td>
            <td>Math</td>
            <td>Science</td>
            <td>Science</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td>9:30 – 10:15</td>
            <td>Science</td>
            <td>Science</td>
            <td>English</td>
            <td>English</td>
            <td>Math</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td>10:15 – 10:30</td>
            <td colspan="5"><strong>Break</strong></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td>10:30 – 11:15</td>
            <td>Social</td>
            <td>Computer</td>
            <td>Social</td>
            <td>Computer</td>
            <td>Social</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td>11:15 – 12:00</td>
            <td>Computer</td>
            <td>Social</td>
            <td>Computer</td>
            <td>Social</td>
            <td>Computer</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
            <td>12:00 – 12:45</td>
            <td>Hindi</td>
            <td>Hindi</td>
            <td>Hindi</td>
            <td>Hindi</td>
            <td>Hindi</td>
        </tr>
    </table>
</body>
</html>

How to Use

  • Task 3: Save the code as wonderland.html and open it in a browser.
  • Task 4: Create the three files (frameset.html, tagore.html, netaji.html) in the same folder. Open frameset.html.
  • Task 5: Save as timetable.html and open.

All code is self-contained and works out-of‑the‑box. Replace the placeholder images with your own if needed.
